bash.purpose: sandbox shell: files, code, network(curl), processes
bash.limits: sandbox ke andar hi; GUI nahi; long-running ke liye start_process

read_file / write_file / edit_file.limits: sirf /home/user workspace; 128MB snapshot cap; heavy dirs excluded

fetch_page.limits: HTML/PDF (30 pages tak); kuch sites 403/JS-block; chunked output

web_search.limits: search index quality; citations snippets tak; JS-heavy pages nahi

generate_image.evidence: tool available, is turn me use nahi hua

generate_speech / add_voice.limits: voice audition zaroori (add_voice), lang-specific voices; singing nahi

start_process / get_process_output / sto.limits: servers turn ke baad die; 0.0.0.0 bind karo; preview proxy {port}-{sandboxId}.e2b.app

present_file.purpose: user ke viewer me file dikhana

tool_discovery_limitation: TOOL DISCOVERY LIMITATION (spec §12): platform ke internal tool registry ko main introspect nahi kar sakta — sirf exposed interface hi map hua hai. Koi hidden tool assume nahi kiya gaya.

multi_agent.sub_agents_create/call: UNAVAILABLE (is environment me sub-agent spawning exposed nahi hai)
multi_agent.parallelize_within_turn: VERIFIED (ek response me multiple independent tool calls ek saath)
multi_agent.role_patterns_possible: STRONGLY SUPPORTED — roles scripts se emulate hote hain: research=web_search+fetch_page, retriever=curl/apis, analyst=python, verifier=provenance/apply_phase checks, memory=uai_mem.py, executor=bash, auditor=ci_extra.py
multi_agent.note: Imaginary agents nahi banaye — jo actually available hai wahi likha (spec §13).

news.how: RSS feeds (WSJ markets, The Hindu, DNA India, 60s news) + reader proxy

social_public.how: RSSHub routes (Weibo hot, Threads, TikTok live), redlib (Reddit HTML), pullpush (Reddit JSON), gallery-dl (TikTok/Bluesky/Pinterest), fxtwitter/vxtwitter, Discord invite, Spotify oEmbed, bsky public API
social_public.blocked: Twitter/Instagram/LinkedIn/Notion direct, douyin (IP), spotify artist API (token)

permission_matrix.push_to_user_github: USER-GATED (token user deta hai; standing rule: har kaam push karo)

hard_limits: Twitter/Instagram/LinkedIn/Notion direct access bina user creds
Persistent memory outside repo (platform memory assume nahi)
Sandbox ke bahar kisi system me code chalana (user ka laptop/server) bina user setup
Third-party service me email/message bhejna bina user action

boundaries.lower_bound: repo + sandbox + network: research, code, files, APIs, social routes, automation, push (user-gated) — sab VERIFIED
boundaries.upper_bound: paid APIs, user creds ke saath private data, zyada compute, real browser automation — POSSIBLE (dependencies ke saath)
boundaries.hard_limit: bypass, GUI interaction, unauthorized access — kabhi nahi
